name: find_symbol
description: Find symbols by exact name, prefix, or suffix. Returns all symbols matching the given names across the codebase. Supports batch: pass an array of names to find multiple symbols in one call; results are grouped per name.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per name (default: 7, max: 50)

match_type.description: Match mode: 'exact' (default, with suffix fallback), 'prefix' (name STARTS WITH), 'suffix' (qual_name ENDS WITH)

symbol_name.description: One or more symbol names to search for. Each name is searched independently. A symbol name is the simple name or qualified ClassName.method, NOT a file path. Example: ["parse_config"] or ["Player.attack", "Enemy.update"].

name: get_call_chain
description: Get the call chain for a function/method. Returns upstream callers and/or downstream callees up to N hops. Accepts either a symbol_id or a symbol_name.

depth.description: Number of hops to traverse (default: 1, max: 5)

direction.description: Direction: 'callers' (who calls this), 'callees' (what this calls), or 'both' (default: 'both')

limit.description: Maximum number of results per direction (default: 7, max: 50)

match_type.description: Match mode for symbol_name resolution: 'exact' (default, with suffix fallback), 'prefix' (name STARTS WITH), 'suffix' (qual_name ENDS WITH). Only used when symbol_name is provided.

params.description: Optional disambiguation for overloaded symbols: filters candidates whose signature matches these params (e.g. 'int a, int b', '(int, int)', or 'double, double'). Only used when symbol_name resolves to multiple candidates.

symbol_id.description: Full symbol ID from search results (e.g. 'src/utils.py:function:parse_config'). Either symbol_id or symbol_name is required.

symbol_name.description: Code symbol name — functions, methods, classes, interfaces, variables. Pass simple name ('parse_config') or qualified ('ClassName.method', 'Player.attack'). Lua 'ClassName:method' and C++/Rust 'ClassName::method' forms also resolve automatically. Resolved automatically. Either symbol_id or symbol_name is required. Single string only; for batch lookup use find_symbol.

name: get_dependencies
description: Find what symbols depend on a given symbol. Shows which functions, classes, or modules reference or call a particular symbol. Also supports asset reference queries: pass file_path to find which config/asset symbols reference that file (reverse dependency), or query a config symbol to see the files it references (forward, via kind + broken flag).

file_path.description: File path (repo-relative) to query reverse asset dependencies for. Returns config/asset symbols that reference this file via REFERENCES_FILE, grouped by kind (material_ref/shader_ref/texture_ref/...), with a broken flag for断链. When set, symbol_id/symbol_name are ignored.

limit.description: Maximum number of 'used by' callers to return (default: 7, max: 50)

description: Get statistics about the code graph: number of files, symbols, call edges, and import edges.

name: query_cypher
description: Execute a read-only Cypher query against the code graph database. Use for counting, ranking, or aggregation questions: 'how many functions in file X?', 'which class has the most methods?', 'what are the most-called functions?', 'find duplicate symbol names', 'how many exported symbols?'. MATCH/CALL/WITH/RETURN/ORDER BY/LIMIT/WHERE allowed; CREATE/DELETE/SET/MERGE/DROP/DETACH/REMOVE blocked. Results capped at 500 rows.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows (default: 50, max: 500)

name: search_code
description: Hybrid code search: full-text keyword (BM25) + semantic vector search (if embeddings enabled), fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Use for fuzzy keyword or concept-based symbol lookup. For exact name lookup or listing symbols in a file, prefer find_symbol.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per match (default: 7, max: 50)

matches.description: Array of search items. Each item is either a plain query string for unconstrained text search, or an object {query, kind?, file_pattern?} with filters. query: keyword text (searches symbol names/signatures/docs). kind: optional comma-separated symbol kinds (function, method, class, interface, variable, constant, field, type, module). file_pattern: optional file path filter. By default a CONTAINS substring (not glob). Prefixed with "re:" it switches to a Go RE2 regexp matched against the FULL file path (e.g. "re:.*\.py$" matches paths ending in .py; "re:src/.*?/api/.*_test\.go" matches Go test files under any api dir). Regex mode resolves paths via the File node table first, then narrows Symbol results — safe for patterns that CONTAINS would misread as literals ("re:a.*\.py" does NOT match the literal string "a.*.py"). Examples: plain text search: ["parse config"]; find all functions in a file: [{"query":"", "kind":"function", "file_pattern":"trade.c"}]; regex-filtered search: [{"query":"Player", "kind":"class", "file_pattern":"re:.*\\.py$"}]

name: search_knowledge
description: Search knowledge documents (.codemaker/codeindex/, .codemaker/knowledge/, openspec/) for business rules, architecture constraints, API descriptions, and boundary conditions. Only available when codeindex/kb-config.json exists. Complements search_code: use search_code for symbol lookup, use search_knowledge for business rules and design context. Knowledge documents are written in Chinese — use Chinese keywords for best results.

limit.description: Maximum number of matched snippets to return (default: 3, max: 10)

module.description: Optional: restrict search to a specific module path (e.g. 'scripts/combat'). Matches any doc path containing this substring.

query.description: Keyword or business concept to search for. Use Chinese for Chinese docs. Multiple space-separated terms are scored independently — lines matching more terms rank higher.
